description: Per-window capability of a terminal window opened beside a session that already has a window of its own (ADR 0131). It is that session's shells and nothing else: the five terminal commands, its own close and destroy scoped to its own label, and the close-request event it ends its shell on. Every terminal command still checks that the window's label names the session it acts on, and the host re-reads its own `terminal` grant for every shell. No screen, input, keyboard, file, tunnel, grant or settings command, and no wildcard entries.
